# Jubilees Chapter 49 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Detailed Passover halakhah — the most extensive Passover legislation in Jubilees

---

**49:1** Remember the commandment which the LORD commanded thee concerning the Passover, that thou shouldest celebrate it in its season, on the fourteenth of the first month, that thou shouldest kill it before it is evening, and that they should eat it by night on the evening of the fifteenth from the time of the going down of the sun.

**49:2** For on this night — the beginning of the festival and the beginning of the joy — ye were eating the Passover in Egypt, when all the powers of Mastema had been let loose to slay all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the firstborn of the captive maidservant in the mill, and to the cattle.

**49:3** And this is the sign which the LORD gave them: into every house on the posts of which they saw the blood of a lamb of the first year, into that house they went not to slay, but it passed by; and for this reason it was called the Passover, that the LORD passed over the houses of the children of Israel.

**49:4** And the powers of Mastema — the destroyer — had no power over the children of Israel on that night.

**49:5** And the LORD protected the houses of Israel on that night from the destroying angel, so that he should not harm any of them — neither their men nor their cattle nor their dogs.

**49:6** And the destroying angel came not into the houses of the children of Israel that night, because the LORD had set a mark upon them.

**49:7** And thou shalt celebrate this ordinance at its appointed time, after thou hast entered into the land which the LORD will give thee as an inheritance.

**49:8** Eat it on the fourteenth of the first month, between the evenings, from the third part of the day to the third part of the night, for two portions of the day are given for the light and one third for the evening.

**49:9** This is what the LORD commanded thee. And do not delay from the evening till darkness, and from the darkness eat it with fire before it is morning.

**49:10** Do not break any bone of it. For thus it is written and ordained: let them not leave any of it until morning, and let them not break any bone; for it is a day of the feast, a day of joy.

**49:11** And ye shall eat it with haste. Its head with its legs and its entrails and with unleavened bread and bitter herbs shall ye eat it. And ye shall drink wine and blood of the grape.

**49:12** Ye shall not carry the flesh of the Passover beyond the gate. Ye shall not break any bone of it. For no uncircumcised man shall eat of it.

**49:13** Every male in Israel shall be circumcised; and every uncircumcised male shall not eat of the Passover.

**49:14** A sojourner and a hired servant shall not eat of it. And it shall not be carried from the house outside to another house, for it is most holy.

**49:15** And ye shall all eat it together, ye who are in one house. Eat it outside nor carry flesh out of the house.

**49:16** All the children of Israel shall observe it in its season, every year, once a year, on its day, within the commandment and according to its ordinance.

**49:17** And thou shalt not delay the Passover sacrifice on any day of the days; it is the Passover of the LORD, and it shall be observed on its day.

**49:18** For I have ordained in the heavenly tablets that they shall observe the Passover on the fourteenth of the first month, and that the Passover sacrifice shall be slaughtered before it is evening.

**49:19** And that they shall eat it at night on the evening of the fifteenth until the third part of the night, and that whatever is left over of all its flesh from the third part of the night onward shall be burned with fire.

**49:20** And they shall not cook it with water, nor shall they eat it raw, but roasted over the fire; its head with its legs and its entrails.

**49:21** And ye shall not break a bone thereof. For no bone of the children of Israel shall be broken.

**49:22** Therefore the LORD commanded the children of Israel to observe the Passover on its day, and not to break any bone of it.

**49:23** It is a statute of forever ordained in the heavenly tablets; and there is no passing over the commandment.

---

*EMET notes: Chapter 49 is the most detailed Passover legislation in Jubilees. It establishes the exact timing (14th of the first month, between the two evenings), the ritual requirements (roasting, no broken bones, blood on doorposts), and the prohibitions (no uncircumcised males, no carrying flesh outside the house). The role of Mastema's destroyer (vv.2-4) in the night is unique to Jubilees, making explicit the connection between the Passover and cosmic warfare. The heavenly tablets authority (v.23) underlies all the legislation.*
